label: winner or champion of
definition: X won competition, race, championship, prize or award Y.
scope_notes: Preserves event/award winner scope. Y is the event or award, not a defeated opponent, political office, general venue or issuing organization unless the event referent is recoverable. Presence and participation alone do not qualify. The distribution substantially mixes event winning with travel/presence and political control; do not broaden winner to all in/go-to associations.

facts.reason: Mets explicitly win World Series title in two rows.
Americans are present, serve, fight, visit, die or are missing in Vietnam; no event/award won.
Nixon goes to and visits China; travel is the competing meaning.
Meyer owns Union Square Cafe, not an event/award victory.
Sosnik is White House adviser/director; no event or award win.
